sampling: nearest pixel floor(x+.5), explicit mask, no filling, duplicate samples excluded
protocol: All 40 inventoried train depth maps; reject incomplete temporal pairs explicitly; no quality-based selection
temporal_limit: 50 ms causal accumulated images shifted 20 ms overlap by 30 ms; not instantaneous observations
timing_limit: Cached depth: timings exclude original stereo/depth calculation and are not end-to-end latency
quality: No reviewed real motion labels; residuals are candidates, not confirmed moving objects
